title: Recorded media alignment
responsibility: Aligns recorded before-and-after media while retaining each side’s own provenance or gap.

inputs.name: comparisonChoices.base
inputs.description: Earlier revision and its selected record, which may be null.

inputs.name: comparisonChoices.head
inputs.description: Later revision and its selected record, which may be null.

inputs.name: harnessComparison.choice
inputs.description: Scenario plus optional empty state/viewport selectors; empty state or viewport includes all matching choices.

outputs.name: comparisonChoices
outputs.description: Sorted unique scenario, state and viewport choices from scenarios containing screenshot or audio media on either side.

outputs.name: harnessComparison
outputs.description: Gallery items paired by scenario, state, evidence and viewport-or-kind, plus readable aligned-state summaries. Missing sides receive explicit gaps. Captures keep their own provenance, and no other revision fills a gap.
